title: Introduction to GCubeR
text: Forest quantification become increasingly important recent years. Whether goal anticipate financial flows, estimate standing timber value, quantify carbon stored forest, working tree volume equations rarely straightforward. Formulas often difficult find, coefficients vary species, implementations can tedious error-prone. GCubeR provides unified user-friendly toolbox brings together commonly used allometric equations forestry. input variables, package handles calculations . GCubeR includes implementations Algan, Rondeux, Dagnelie, Vallet volume equations, well CNPF Vallet’s methods estimating biomass, carbon content, CO₂ equivalent. vignette walks workflow applying GCubeR dataset shows extract useful information forest inventory.
